title: Ruins of Clonmacnois
html_source:
Another sixth century monastic structure in County Offaly on the River Shannon in the middle of Ireland, founded in 544 by St. Ciarán. It became a major center of religion, learning, craft, and trade, visited as it was by scholars from across Europe. Many high kings of Tara and Connacht were buried there.

The list goes on adumbrating important heritage sites in Ireland and the Hebrides.
